subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: How should maintainers split and prioritize the remaining CLI/TUI session default, WeChat route identity, background-event flood, and meaningful-activity timestamp work in #88204?
rationale: The issue spans core TUI/Gateway session semantics, external WeChat routing, and subagent/cron event policy, so automation cannot safely choose the owner boundary or activity taxonomy.

options.title: Split into canonical issues
options.body: Keep this umbrella open only long enough to link or create focused canonical items for TUI defaults, WeChat routing proof, flood/deadlock handling, and #51028 meaningful activity.

options.title: Choose one core session-state design
options.body: Treat the issue as a single core session-state initiative and require a maintainer-authored design before implementation.

options.title: Close only after live proof shows all slices fixed
options.body: Do not split yet, but require live current-main proof that the merged adjacent fixes cover every reported behavior before cleanup close.

recommendation.title: Split into canonical issues
recommendation.body: Keep this umbrella open only long enough to link or create focused canonical items for TUI defaults, WeChat routing proof, flood/deadlock handling, and #51028 meaningful activity.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined signal across related session UI/product and subagent/session-runtime history, while individual fixes still need area owners.
